commands.command:
pwd && rg --files -g 'build.py' -g 'tests/**' -g 'content/**' -g 'README.md' | sort && sed -n '1,260p' build.py && printf '
--- tests/test_readme.py ---
' && sed -n '1,320p' tests/test_readme.py && printf '
--- README.md ---
' && sed -n '1,320p' README.md
rg -n "^(def |class |    def )|content/(posts|links|patches|images)|tags|type|title|written|site-build|stderr|print\(" build.py | tail -n 220 && sed -n '260,760p' build.py
sed -n '740,1225p' build.py && printf '\n--- existing tests summaries ---\n' && sed -n '1,260p' tests/test_s1.py && sed -n '1,300p' tests/test_s2.py && sed -n '1,300p' tests/test_s3.py
git status --short && git diff -- README.md && git diff --stat

sed -n '1,260p' plan/PLAN.md && printf '\n--- tracked/changed metadata task records ---\n' && sed -n '1,220p' .chongdae/run-20260923-145003-9b81/tasks/readme.json && sed -n '1,220p' .chongdae/run-20260923-145003-9b81/tasks/readme-tests.json
